spec:
Add an optional dispatcher that takes next's actions and runs each as a non-interactive local codex or claude CLI process in the goal worktree, minting the holder label, running start/renew/submit, and capturing logs. Support routing.tiers preferences such as 'review nodes prefer a different provider than the subject holder', with explicit behaviour when a provider is unavailable. Reuse each CLI's existing auth, never copy credentials, and keep human items on the root conversation. Independence remains holder-label inequality; provider difference is a preference, not proof. Changed vs old wording: no new lease/ownership machinery; it drives the existing verbs.

Migrated from GitHub issue #550 after the engine reset (#740).
- This PR edits docs/design/SPEC.md and DESIGN.md for every contract change it makes and adds a HISTORY §4 row.
title: Launch and supervise local Codex and Claude workers for frontier actions
